user.title: Person
user.description: One person with their accounts on the sites (e.g. JOYclub, poppen.de). The accounts appear by themselves when the script in this person's browser sends for the first time.

init.title: Address for the scripts
init.description:
Enter this address in the script's settings (JOYclub: Opa-Schutz › General › Home Assistant) – complete, including the part after “#”:

`{address}`

The part after “#” is the key; it never leaves the browser, the data arrives encrypted. Do not share the address.

data.renew: Issue a new address (the old one stops working)

user.title: Add account
user.description: Usually not needed: an account appears by itself once its script sends.

not_a_person.message: Pick a person of the Fickliste (a device of Swinger Companion below a person).

notes_too_long.message: This note is longer than 255 characters – change it with the action “Set note”.

bad_folder.message: This folder does not exist or Home Assistant may not read it (allowed: below the configuration folder or in allowlist_external_dirs).

set_status.name: Set status
set_status.description: Changes the status of a person; the scripts take it over with their next transfer.

status.name: Status
status.description: none, want, done, no or never.

set_notes.name: Set note
set_notes.description: Replaces the note of a person (up to 8000 characters).

notes.name: Note
notes.description: New text; empty removes the note.

add_meet.name: Add meeting
add_meet.description: Adds a meeting with a person; the scripts take it over with their next transfer.

link.name: Link
link.description: Optional link, e.g. to the party.

import_files.name: Import pictures and videos
import_files.description: Takes over all pictures and videos of a folder for a person; duplicates (also similar pictures in another size) are left out.

path.name: Folder
path.description: Folder on the Home Assistant host, e.g. /config/swinger_companion/import/alex.
